sample_unit: valid survey responses from members of the general public aged 12 and over

links.outcome: Proportion of respondents using consumer AI chatbots for self-directed health purposes
links.effect: 72.5% aware of AI chatbots, 26.4% used them; uses included health coaching 67.5%, self-medication 54.5%, self-diagnosis 44.1%, mental support 48%. ChatGPT most used (22.65%).
links.quote: While 72.5% were aware of AI chatbots, only 26.4% used them, primarily for health coaching (67.5%), self-medication (54.5%), self-diagnosis (44.1%), and mental support (48%).

screen.reason: Multinational cross-sectional survey examining the public's real-world practices and attitudes regarding generative AI chatbots (such as ChatGPT) for healthcare assistance.
